title: Candidate Dashboard Real MariaDB Metrics Aggregation & Multi-Step Onboarding
spec:
### 1. MANDATE & PROBLEM STATEMENT
src/services/api/platform.js:1898 defines getStatesOfUser as a hardcoded stub returning [].
Consequently, candidate counters for resumes, cover letters, and applications show 0 despite existing records.
Furthermore, the candidate onboarding checklist contains only 1 single hardcoded step.

### 2. ARCHITECTURAL SPECIFICATION
1. Author GET /api/user-stats in backend aggregating user document counts (resumes, covers, portfolios, applications).
2. Connect getStatesOfUser to call /api/user-stats.
3. Update DashboardHomepage.jsx and CubaCandidateHero.jsx to render honest metrics.
4. Expand candidate onboarding checklist to track completion of Profile, First Resume, Cover Letter, and First Job Application.

### 3. IMPLEMENTATION PLAN
- S1: Author GET /api/user-stats in backend/routes/platform.js.
- S2: Connect getStatesOfUser in src/services/api/platform.js.
- S3: Update DashboardHomepage.jsx to consume live stats.
- S4: Update CubaCandidateHero.jsx to reflect live stats.
- S5: Expand onboarding checklist.
- S6: Author test suite tests/dir058-dashboard-stats.test.mjs.
